name: Wings of Velis Vel — "has base power and toughness 4/4, gains all creature types, and gains flying"
notes: Partial sweep (single cards, 2026-10-12). Cast as a spell, the target was a 4/4 flier but still only a Bear: "gains all creature types" was read after "and" but not as the middle item of a comma list. (Added as a permanent, the card's own Changeling had hidden the miss.) The target is every creature type; the other creature is untouched.
